### 2026-10-08 – Selected Specific Parts Suitable By Going Through The Specs Sheet Of Each And Every Item. Here Are The Main Ones:

**6h**

Selected Specific Parts Suitable By Going Through The Specs Sheet Of Each And Every Item. Here Are The Main Ones:

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 212023](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/QTavktDBTaeTuDI4nnrtPQzMjGTt4U2i/3b9542680516fb2b31246755f9bfdc813997fd7685cf5036332d1b432af91a1b.png)

The A7670C Module supports wireless communication modes of LTE-TDD/LTE-FDD/GSM/GPRS/EDGE. It supports maximum 10Mbps downlink rate and 5Mbps uplink rate. The A7670 series supports multiple built-in network protocols, supports drivers for main operation systems (USB driver for Windows, Linux and Android etc.) and software function, AT commands are compatible with SIM7500/SIM7600 series modules.

The A7670 series adopts LGA form factor and is compatible with SIM7000/SIM7070 series, and SIM800A/SIM800F(2G modules) which enables smooth migration from 2G/NB/Cat M products to LTE Cat 1 products, and greatly facilitates more compatible product design for the customer needs.

Meanwhile the A7670 series integrates main industrial standard interfaces, with powerful expansibility, including abundant interfaces such as UART, USB, I2C, GPIO, which is suitable for main IOT applications such as telematics, surveillance devices, POS, industrial routers, remote diagnostics etc.

Features :

Small size  LTE Cat 1 module
Supports  LTE-FDD, LTE-TDD, and GSM, frequency bands
Control via AT commands
SIM Card Holder
Power LED and Network Status
Powerful TCP/IP protocol stack for internet data transfer
Supports maximum 10Mbps downlink rate and 5Mbps uplink rate
DC Jack input voltage  :  7-12V
RS232  DB9 Connector interface
SMA  connector for external antenna
1.8V UART header
Abundant software functions  : FOTA, LBS, SSL
The form factor of A7670 series are compatible with the SIM7000/SIM7070 series

Datasheet

Package includes :

1 x A7670C 4G/2G Module

ESP32 38-Pin WiFi + Bluetooth NodeMCU Development Board
The ESP32 38-Pin WiFi + Bluetooth NodeMCU Development Board is a versatile microcontroller development board designed for IoT, home automation, robotics, embedded systems, and wireless electronics projects. Built around the ESP-WROOM-32 module, it combines a powerful dual-core processor with built-in WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity, allowing you to develop connected applications without requiring separate wireless modules.

With 38 pins and multiple GPIO, PWM, ADC, DAC, UART, SPI, and I2C interfaces, the board provides flexible connectivity for sensors, displays, motors, relays, and other electronic components. Its compatibility with the Arduino IDE makes it accessible to students and beginners while providing the processing capability required for more advanced IoT and embedded projects.

Whether you are developing a smart home system, wireless sensor network, robotics project, data logger, or connected prototype, this ESP32 development board provides a practical combination of processing power, wireless connectivity, and peripheral support.

The board is also suitable for developers looking for an affordable ESP32 NodeMCU board for IoT and embedded applications, with a large developer community and extensive software support.

Features
ESP-WROOM-32 Module
The ESP-WROOM-32 module combines processing and wireless capabilities in a compact platform, making it suitable for connected IoT and embedded applications.

Dual-Core Processor
The dual-core processor provides the processing capability needed for multitasking applications involving wireless communication, sensors, automation, and data processing.

Built-in WiFi & Bluetooth
Integrated WiFi and Bluetooth allow the board to communicate wirelessly with networks, smartphones, sensors, and other connected devices without requiring additional communication modules.

38-Pin Design
The 38-pin layout provides access to multiple GPIO and peripheral interfaces, giving developers greater flexibility when connecting sensors, displays, motors, and other components.

Arduino IDE Compatibility
Arduino IDE compatibility simplifies programming and prototyping, making the board suitable for beginners as well as experienced developers working on ESP32 projects.

Low-Power Operation
Its power-efficient design makes the ESP32 suitable for battery-powered IoT devices, wireless sensors, monitoring systems, and other embedded applications.

1.8 inch TFT LCD Module
This is the 1.8 inch TFT LCD Module. This TFT LCD display module communicates via 4-wire SPI and has its own pixel-addressable frame buffer; it can be used with any type of microcontroller, even very small ones with limited memory and few available pins.

The 1.8″ TFT LCD display features 128×160 colour pixels. This display is a true TFT, unlike low-cost “Nokia 6110” and similar LCD displays, which are CSTN type and thus have poor colour and slow refresh. The ST7735R TFT driver can display full 18-bit colour (262,144 shades!), making it ideal for vibrant graphical interfaces.

If you're comparing the 1.8 inch TFT LCD price India, this module offers a great balance between performance and affordability for DIY electronics, embedded systems, and IoT projects.

The LCD will always come with the same driver chip, so you won’t have to worry about compatibility issues across units. The TFT display is soldered to the breakout (using a delicate flex-circuit connector), along with an ultra-low-dropout 3.3V regulator and a 3/5V level shifter, allowing seamless use with both 3.3V and 5V systems.

If you want to use this 1.8 inch TFT LCD display Module with Arduino, in your project for that you will need few essential components like

breadboard
jumper wires
Features:
Display Size: 1.8 inch TFT
Resolution: 128 × 160 pixels
Driver IC: ST7735R
Interface: SPI (4-wire)
Operating Voltage: 3.3V / 5V compatible
Built-in voltage regulator and level shifter
Full RGB colour support (18-bit)
Compact and lightweight design
